about: A readout of an S61 on Sonoff's firmware, the readout firmware sent spoilt (--simulate-bad-image readout): Sonoff's firmware refuses it, and once the wait is out still answers (arrival.still_on_sonoff), so the run stops saying it was not installed, never asking for the device to be switched off and on; the readout run again, as a person would, reads it whole
